Order No. 89 of 2024

My Ref. No.: 4-3/2/2012/FR/270. Divisional Secretary's Ref. No.: KDS/MIN/4/8/7-3. BY virtue of the powers vested in me Order under Section 38 (a) of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460), I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation do hereby direct the Acquiring Oﬃ cer or any other oﬃ cer authorised by him referred to in Paragraph 1of the Schedule to take immediate possession of the land speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of that Schedule.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/06,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.04th December, 2024.
SCHEDULE
1. Acquiring Oﬃ cer - Divisional Secretary, Minipe.

2. Description of the land - The allotments of land depicted in following names and extents as indicated in the F.V.P. 320, Land Description Page No 36. Supplement No. 1. Sheet No. dated 03.06.2019 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Alawala Udagaladebokka in No. 899 Udagaldebokka Grama Niladhari Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Minipe in Kandy District of Central Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot No. 308 - Yahangala watta - Extent: About 9.8093 Hectare North: Lot Nos. 112 and 303; East: Lot Nos. 303, 301 and 306; South: Lot Nos. 306 and 173; West: Lot No.173.
02. Lot No. 309 - Yahangala watta - Extent: About 9.5932 Hectare North: Lot Nos.144, 172 and 296; East: Lot No. 173; South: Lot Nos. 299, 144, 174, and 175; West: Lot Nos. 175, 298, 144, and 172.
